$comment: The game's own names and descriptions, from the EU disc's str_tbl (mhfu-extract disc-text). Arrays are indexed by game ID: items by item ID (data/items.json), equipment as in data/equipment-ids.json, skill_trees by SkillID and skills by skill ID. ID 0 is null. Names are the EU disc's, which can differ from the site's. Descriptions keep the game's line breaks; color codes are removed.

items.name: Book of Combos 1
items.description:
Intro text for first-time
combiners. Improves your
combining success rate.

items.name: Book of Combos 2
items.description:
Basic text. Together
with 1, improves your
combining success rate.

items.name: Book of Combos 3
items.description:
Intermediate text. Along
with 1 & 2, improves your
combining success rate.

items.name: Book of Combos 4
items.description:
Advanced text. Along with
1, 2, and 3, improves your
combining success rate.

items.name: Book of Combos 5
items.description:
Pro text. Along with 1,
2, 3, and 4, improves your
combining success rate.

items.name: Alchemy Guide
items.description:
With this book, you too
can use alchemy. What will
you create?

items.name: Potion
items.description:
Restores a small amount of
Health.

items.name: Mega Potion
items.description:
Restores a moderate amount
of Health.

items.name: Nutrients
items.description:
Increases the maximum
Health level slightly.

items.name: Mega Nutrients
items.description:
Medicine that increases
the maximum Health level
by a small amount.

items.name: Antidote
items.description:
Effectively removes all
traces of poison from your
system.

items.name: Immunizer
items.description:
Medicine that enhances
natural recovery ability.

items.name: Power Juice
items.description:
Allows you to run without
becoming fatigued for a
period of time.

items.name: Mega Juice
items.description:
Allows you to run without
fatiguing for even
longer than Power Juice.

items.description:
Increases Attack power,
bestowing the strength
of Asura himself on user.

items.name: Mega Demondrug
items.description:
Increases Attack power
even more than Demondrug.

items.name: Power Pill
items.description:
A strengthening pill that
endows you with the power
of a fierce god.

items.name: Armorskin
items.description:
Increases Defense
by hardening your skin
to stone-like armor.

items.name: Mega Armorskin
items.description:
Increases Defense
even more than Armorskin.

items.name: Armor Pill
items.description:
A pill that temporarily
makes your skin as hard as
metal.

items.name: Cool Drink
items.description:
A drink that bestows
temporary resistance
to extreme heat.

items.name: Hot Drink
items.description:
A drink that bestows
temporary resistance
to extreme cold.

items.name: Thawing Agent
items.description:
A chemical agent that
melts away the frozen
tundra in the soul.

items.name: Psychoserum
items.description:
Temporarily activates
an ESP-like ability to
sense monsters.

items.name: Monster Fluid
items.description:
Can be mixed with
insect stomach juices
to make an adhesive.

items.name: Monster Broth
items.description:
A broth made from only the
thickest of a monster's
juices. Quite rich.

items.name: Monster Essence
items.description:
Further distilled monster
broth, although I don't
recommend touching it...

items.name: Thunderbug Juice
items.description:
Fluids of a Thunderbug.
When stockpiled, can cause
an electrical discharge.

items.name: Thunderbug Jelly
items.description:
Gelatin from a Great
Thunderbug. More powerful
than Juice. Easier to use.

items.name: Herbal Medicine
items.description:
Effectively cures poison,
and restores a slight
amount of Health.

items.name: Max Potion
items.description:
Restores Health to the
maximum level, enabling
a full recovery.

items.name: Ancient Potion
items.description:
Restores Health and
Stamina to maximum levels,
enabling a full recovery.

items.name: Catalyst
items.description:
Mixes with other materials
to improve their effect.
Cannot be used by itself.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.description:
Recovers Stamina and cures
fatigue. Approved by the
Guild.

items.name: Gunpowder
items.description:
A dangerous chemical
that explodes when
disturbed or heated.

items.name: Lifecrystals
items.description:
Mysterious crystals
long worshipped as a
fount of life.

items.name: Lifepowder
items.description:
Medicine created by
combining Lifecrystals.
Strong restorative power.

items.name: Powercharm
items.description:
Amulet that raises Attack
power. The holder gains
the strength of a demon.

items.name: Powertalon
items.description:
Amulet that raises
Attack. Made from a
Lao-Shan's Claw.

items.name: Armorcharm
items.description:
Amulet that causes one's
skin to become as hard as
stone. Raises Defense.

items.name: Armortalon
items.description:
Amulet that raises
Defense. Made from a
Lao-Shan's Claw.

items.name: Tranquilizer
items.description:
Medicine that is used
as an anesthetic when
combined.

items.name: Raw Meat
items.description:
Meat obtained through
carving up a monster.
Has many uses.

items.name: Poisoned Meat
items.description:
Poisons if consumed.
Used as bait in traps.

items.name: Tainted Meat
items.description:
Paralyzes if consumed.
Used as bait in traps.

items.name: Drugged Meat
items.description:
Causes sleepiness if
consumed. Used as
bait in traps.

items.name: Rare Steak
items.description:
Meat cooked on the
rare side. Gives a small
boost to Stamina.

items.name: Well-Done Steak
items.description:
Well-cooked meat.
Gives a medium boost
to Stamina.

items.name: Gourmet Steak
items.description:
A gourmet steak cooked to
perfection. Gives a full
boost to Stamina.

items.name: Burnt Meat
items.description:
Meat burnt to a crisp.
Boosts Stamina sometimes,
but can also weaken you.

items.name: Hot Meat
items.description:
Eat to warm the body, ward
off the cold, and even
recover a bit of Stamina.

items.name: Cold Meat
items.description:
Eat to cool the body, ward
off the heat, and even
recover a bit of Stamina.

items.name: Rare Fish
items.description:
A lightly brazed fish.
Recovers red portion of
Health Gauge when eaten.

items.name: Gourmet Fish
items.description:
Recover the red portion of
the Health gauge and
increase natural recovery.

items.name: Gourmet Fish+
items.description:
Recovers red portion of
the Health gauge and
increases resilience.

items.name: Burnt Fish
items.description:
A fish burnt to a crisp.
Sometimes recovers Health,
but can also harm you...

items.name: Boomerang
items.description:
Returns when thrown. A
peculiar shaped weapon
from a foreign land.

items.name: Throwing Knife
items.description:
A standard throwing knife.
Goes straight to a target.
(Supply Item)

items.name: Poison Thrw Knf
items.description:
Throwing knife with a
poison edge. Has a toxic
effect. (Supply Item)

items.name: Sleeping Thr Knf
items.description:
Throwing knife with an
edge daubed with sleeping
powder. (Supply Item)

items.name: Paralyze Thr Knf
items.description:
Throwing knife with a
paralysis toxin coated
edge. (Supply Item)

items.name: Tranq Thrwng Knf
items.description:
A knife made to assist in
the capture of monsters it
strikes. (Supply Item)

items.name: Bomb Material
items.description:
Basic ingredient for
making hand-thrown bombs.

items.name: Paintball
items.description:
Can be thrown at a
monster to mark it
for easy tracking.

items.name: Flash Bomb
items.description:
Bomb that flashes
brightly upon impact.
Blinds monsters.

items.name: Sonic Bomb
items.description:
Emits a powerful,
high-frequency sound
upon detonation.

items.name: Dung
items.description:
Monster excrement. One
dropping can maximize the
fertility of a row.

items.name: Wyvern Droppings
items.description:
Wyvern excrement. One
dropping can maximize the
fertility of all rows.

items.name: Dung Bomb
items.description:
Creates a terrible smell
upon impact, which certain
wyverns dislike.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.description:
Creates a large cloud of
smoke in the area where
it lands.

items.name: Poison Smoke Bmb
items.description:
Smoke bomb containing a
toxic chemical. Popular as
a household bug bomb.

items.name: Farcaster
items.description:
Instantly transports
you back to base camp.

items.name: Deodorant
items.description:
Removes item usage blocks.
When thrown on the ground,
its smoke deodorizes.

items.name: Tranq Bomb
items.description:
Use to subdue and capture
a trapped monster.

items.name: Spiderweb
items.description:
A spider's web.
Very sticky.

items.name: Net
items.description:
Powerful net able to
withstand a certain
amount of weight.

items.name: Trap Tool

A tool needed to set up
various types of traps,
such as the Pitfall Trap.

items.name: Pitfall Trap
items.description:
Trap for catching certain
large monsters. It is
tripped by a heavy weight.

items.name: Shock Trap
items.description:
A trap that can immobilize

capturing.

items.name: Lightning Rod
items.description:
Will attract lightning
after a while. Can be
used in the rain.

items.name: Barrel Lid
items.description:
A small barrel lid.
There appears to be a
drawing on it.

items.name: Small Barrel
items.description: A small, empty barrel.

items.name: Large Barrel
items.description: A large, empty barrel.

items.name: Sm Barrel-Bomb
items.description: A small time-bomb.

items.name: Sm Barrel-Bomb+
items.description:
Upgraded Small Barrel
Bomb. Not to be taken
lightly despite its size.

items.name: Lg Barrel-Bomb
items.description:
Powerful bomb triggered
by external physical
impact.

items.name: Lg Barrel-Bomb+
items.description:
Upgraded Large Barrel
Bomb. Effective against
large monsters.

items.name: Bounce Bomb
items.description:
Bounces into the air when
set. This modified bomb
requires skill to use.

items.name: Bounce Bomb+
items.description:
Improved version of the
Bounce Bomb. Requires
some skill to use.

items.name: Anti-Dragon Bomb
items.description:
Small time bomb that
attaches to an enemy.
(Supply Item)

items.name: Huskberry
items.description:
An empty berry that can
grow anywhere. Try
planting it in the field.

items.name: Sm Bone Husk

Bone ammunition casing.
Stronger than a Huskberry
ammunition casing.

items.name: Lg Bone Husk

Bone ammunition casing
that can withstand
powerful explosions.

items.description:
Inexpensive ammo for
novices, but don't expect
much. Unlimited shots.

items.name: Normal S Lv2
items.description:
Normal ammo that is more
powerful than Normal S
Lv1. Maximum of 99 shots.

items.name: Normal S Lv3
items.description:
Normal ammo that causes
more damage than its
predecessor. Max 99 shots.

items.name: Pierce S Lv1

Piercing round that causes
multiple hits to monsters.
Max 60 shots.

items.name: Pierce S Lv2
items.description:
Piercing round that causes
more hits than Lv1 ammo.
Max 60 shots.

items.name: Pierce S Lv3
items.description:
Piercing round that causes

items.name: Pellet S Lv2
items.description:
Sprays a wide area,
causing more hits than Lv1
ammo. Max 60 shots.

items.name: Pellet S Lv3
items.description:
Sprays a wide area,
causing the most hits in
the class. Max 60 shots.

and stunning. Max 9 shots.

Very powerful & stunning

explodes. Max 9 shots.

items.name: Crag S Lv3
items.description:
Tremendously powerful and
stunning shot. Penetrates
and explodes. Max 9 shots.

Splits into 3 bombs upon
impact. Beware of friendly
fire. Max 3 shots.

Splits into 4 bombs upon
impact. Beware of friendly
fire. Max 3 shots.

Splits into 5 bombs upon
impact. Beware of friendly
fire. Max 3 shots.

Shot effective against
monsters vulnerable
to fire. Max 60 shots.

Shot effective against
monsters vulnerable
to water. Max 60 shots.

items.name: Thunder S
items.description:
Shot effective against
monsters vulnerable
to thunder. Max 60 shots.

items.name: Freeze S
items.description:
Shot effective against
monsters vulnerable
to ice. Max 60 shots.

items.name: Dragon S

Mysterious ammo that can't
be used in normal Bowguns.
Maximum of 3 shots.

items.name: Recov S Lv1
items.description:
Restores a small amount of
Health to the target.
Maximum of 12 shots.

items.name: Recov S Lv2
items.description:
Restores a moderate amount
of Health to the target.
Maximum of 12 shots.

items.name: Poison S Lv1
items.description:
Poisons target, but may
require several shots.
Maximum of 12 shots.

items.name: Poison S Lv2
items.description:
Uses a stronger poison,
but may require several
shots. Max 8 shots.

items.name: Para S Lv1

Paralyzes target, but may
require several shots.
Maximum of 12 shots.

items.name: Para S Lv2
items.description:
Stronger paralysis effect,
but may require several
shots. Max 8 shots.

items.name: Sleep S Lv1
items.description:
Puts target to sleep, but
may require several shots.
Maximum of 12 shots.

items.name: Sleep S Lv2
items.description:
Stronger sleep effect,
but may require several
shots. Max 8 shots.

items.name: Tranq S
items.description:
Tranquilizer for use on
large trapped monsters.
Max 8 shots.

items.name: Paint S
items.description:
Marks a monster's position
on the map for a set time
period. Max 99 shots.

items.name: Demon S
items.description:
Said to bestow the
strength of Asura on
the target. Max 5 shots.

items.name: Armor S
items.description:
Said to make the target's
skin as hard as stone.
Maximum of 5 shots.

items.name: No Coating
items.description: none

items.name: Empty Bottle
items.description:
A bottle with nothing in
it. Nothing more, nothing
less.

items.name: Power Coating
items.description:
Bows loaded with these
bottles will have high
attack power. Max 50.

items.name: Poison Coating
items.description:
Bows loaded with these
bottles poison enemies
on shaft impact. Max 20.

items.name: ParalysisCoating
items.description:
Bows loaded with these
bottles paralyze enemies
on shaft impact. Max 20.

items.name: Sleep Coating
items.description:
Bows loaded with these
bottles will put enemies
to sleep. Max 20.

items.description:
Bows loaded with these get
higher close-range power &
melee Sharpness. Max 20.

items.name: Paint Coating
items.description:
Bows loaded with these
can make monsters appear
on the map. Max 99.

items.name: Cricket
items.description:
Energetic insect that
works well as fishing
bait.

items.name: Worm
items.description:
Nightcrawler for fishing.
Use 5 worms to raise soil
fertility one level.

items.name: Firefly
items.description:
A firefly that's always
glowing. Works well as
fishing bait.

items.name: Frog
items.description:
A frog.
Works well as fishing
bait.

items.name: Tuna Bait
items.description:
The bait preferred by
the tuna family of fish.

items.name: Arrowana Bait
items.description:
The bait preferred by
the arrowana family of
fish.

items.name: Goldenfish Bait
items.description:
The bait preferred by
Goldenfish.

items.name: Mega Fishing Fly
items.description:
A fly lure that causes a
feeding frenzy, no matter
what fish is biting.

items.name: Old Pickaxe
items.description:
A cheap pickaxe with an
easily chipped blade.

items.name: Iron Pickaxe
items.description:
An iron pickaxe with a
strong blade.

items.name: Mega Pickaxe
items.description:
A steel-reinforced
pickaxe that is hard
to chip.

items.name: Expand Pickaxe
items.description:
Small pickaxe that appears
unsuitable for mining. You
sense a strange power...

items.name: Old Bugnet
items.description:
Cheap and easily torn
net for catching bugs.

items.name: Bugnet
items.description:
Strong net for catching
bugs.

items.name: Mega Bugnet
items.description:
Extremely durable net for
catching bugs.

items.name: BBQ Spit
items.description:
A must-have item for
any hunter. Allows for
the cooking of meat.

items.name: Gourmet BBQ Spit
items.description:
A gourmet BBQ spit that
allows you to make Well-
Done Steaks more easily.

items.name: Whetstone
items.description:
A standard whetstone.

it, Sharpness is restored.

items.name: Binoculars
items.description:
Lets you observe from
a distance.

items.name: Garbage
items.description:
Junk created when a
combination attempt
fails.

items.name: Flute
items.description:
A dangerous device used to
attract certain monsters.
May break when used.

items.name: Health Flute
items.description:
Restores the Health of
those who hear it.
May break when used.

items.name: Antidote Flute
items.description:
Eliminates poison in the
blood of those who hear
it. May break when used.

items.name: Demon Flute
items.description:
Increases the strength
of those who hear it.
May break when used.

items.name: Armor Flute
items.description:
Improves the endurance
of those who hear it.
May break when used.

items.name: Honey
items.description:
Normal honey.
Highly nutritious.

items.name: Sunset Herb
items.description:
A strange herb with a
pleasant smell. Good for
combining.

items.name: Herb
items.description:
A plant that restores a
slight amount of Health.

items.name: Antidote Herb
items.description:
Field plant with antidotal
qualities. Relying on it
too heavily poses a risk.

items.name: Fire Herb
items.description:
A plant that has flammable
properties.

items.name: Ivy
items.description:
A lightweight and
extremely strong plant.

items.name: Sleep Herb
items.description:
Plant with sleep-inducing
qualities. Can be planted
in the field.

items.name: Sap Plant
items.description:
A plant with leaves coated
in sticky sap. Difficult
to remove once attached.

items.name: Felvine
items.description:
A Melynx favorite. They
can't resist its charm.

items.name: Cactus Flower
items.description:
Contains antidotal
substances, but has no
effect by itself.

items.name: Hot Pepper
items.description:
Ignites a fire after only
a single bite. Warms you
up, but too hot to handle.

items.name: Dosbiscus
items.description:
A large, beautifully
colored flowering plant
foreign to this land.

items.name: Mountain Herbs
items.description:
Highly valued natural
grass found only in the
mountains. (Account Item)

items.name: Giant Corn
items.description:
Gigantic corn that's hard
to grow in this region.
Packed with kernels.

items.name: Special Mushroom
items.description:
Tiny, difficult to pick. A
Mosswine's favorite food.
(Account Item)

items.name: Select Mushroom
items.description:
Selected from Special
Mushrooms for their size
and taste. (Account Item)

items.name: Blue Mushroom
items.description:
Rare mushroom with a
power-enhancing effect.

items.name: Nitroshroom
items.description:
Rare mushroom with the
power to generate heat.

items.name: Parashroom
items.description:
Mushroom that induces a
paralysis effect.

items.name: Toadstool
items.description:
A poisonous fungus.
Perhaps it has other
effects as well...

items.name: Exciteshroom
items.description:
A mushroom with a very
strange smell. What would
happen if you ate it...?

items.name: Dragon Toadstool
items.description:
A dangerous fungus
said to draw the life
out of people. Beware.

items.name: Spicy Mushroom
items.description:
Special Spicy Mushroom
that recovers a small
amount of Stamina.

items.name: Chaos Mushroom
items.description:
Said to cause chaos. Its
spores cause monsters to
hallucinate.

items.name: Paintberry
items.description:
Releases a smelly paint-
like juice when broken.
Can be planted.

items.name: Power Seed
items.description:
Temporarily raises Attack
power. Short-lived effect
if used raw. Plantable.

items.name: Armor Seed
items.description:
Temporarily increases
Defense when consumed.
Very invigorating.

items.name: Dragon Seed
items.description:
Mysterious berry said
to be hated by dragons.

items.name: Scatternut
items.description:
A nut that shatters
to pieces when subjected
to an impact.

items.name: Needleberry
items.description:
Berry covered in needle-
like thorns. Can be made
into bullets. Plantable.

items.name: Bomberry
items.description:
A berry that explodes
when subjected to
an impact.

items.name: Tropical Berry
items.description:
A blood red berry grown
in the scorching heat.
(Account Item)

items.name: Frozen Berry
items.description:
A completely frozen berry.
Can provide relief from
heat and recover Stamina.

items.name: Red Seed
items.description:
A strange red seed of
unknown variety. Can be
planted in the field.

items.name: Green Seed
items.description:
A strange green seed of
unknown variety. Can be
planted in the field.

items.name: Yellow Seed
items.description:
A strange yellow seed of
unknown variety. Can be
planted in the field.

items.name: Beautiful Shell
items.description:
A beautiful shell with a
faint tinge of color.
(Account Item)

items.name: Black Pearl
items.description:
Taken from the depths of a
shell. Valued as treasure,
as well as material.

items.name: Giant Blk Pearl
items.description:
Largest and most beautiful
of all Black Pearls. Very
valuable and hard to find.

items.name: Stone
items.description:
A small rock.
Can be thrown.

items.name: Disk Stone
items.description: A disk-shaped stone.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description:
Ore that can be smelted
into metal and used for
many different purposes.

items.name: Earth Crystal
items.description:
Crystallized remains of
micro biotic organisms. A
prized weapon abrasive.

items.name: Machalite Ore
items.description:
Better than Iron Ore.
Used to make Machalite.
Also called Sparrowstone.

items.name: Dragonite Ore
items.description:
Better than Machalite.
Extremely valuable.
Also called Dragonstone.

items.name: Carbalite Ore
items.description:
An experimental ore also
called Spiritstone, it is
superior to Dragonite.

items.name: Eltalite Ore
items.description:
Better than Carbalite Ore.
New material with great
potential. AKA Kitestone.

items.name: Union Ore
items.description:
Ore with a metal that can
fuse any other material
together. AKA Dovestone.

items.name: Mellanje Ore
items.description:
Soft, easy to work with
Ore that combines well.
AKA Pidgeonstone.

items.name: Firestone
items.description:
Combusts at room temp. Mix
with suitable materials
only. AKA Phoenixstone.

items.name: Firecell Stone
items.description:
A magma-like ore. Only to
be handled by trained
hands. AKA Eagle's Eye.

items.name: Coal
items.description:
A combustible rock that
emits a faint warmth.
(Account Item)

items.name: Goldstone Piece
items.description:
A small, pure piece of
Goldstone. Commands a
high price. (Account Item)

items.name: Goldstone Hunk
items.description:
Massive hunk of precious
Goldstone. Its shine grabs
the eye. (Account Item)

items.description:
Crystal with a dull glow.

for tools in the armory.

Brightly glowing crystal.

for tools in the armory.

workshop machinery.

Ore with a unique reaction
to heat. Can be combined
to make an armor coating.

items.name: Armor Sphere
items.description:
Its unique reaction to
heat can be used to
increase armor strength.

items.name: Armor Sphere+
items.description:
Dense and high quality.
Treasured as a supplement
to armor strength.

items.name: Hrd Armor Sphere
items.description:
Hard, high density Armor
Sphere. Rare material used
in high strength armor.

items.name: Hvy Armor Sphere
items.description:
Thick, dense Armor Sphere.
Rarely obtained, it raises
the bar on armor strength.

items.name: Ryl Armor Sphere
items.description:
Incredibly rare Armor
Sphere with a sparkle.
Further improves armor.

items.name: Tru Armor Sphere
items.description:
Near impossible to find
Armor Sphere with hard to
extract latent abilities.

items.name: Knife Mackerel
items.description:
A fish with a dorsal fin
hard enough to be used
to sharpen weapons.

items.name: Sushifish
items.description:
A delicious fish that
restores a small amount
of Health when consumed.

items.name: Sleepyfish
items.description:
A fish with sleep-inducing
properties.

items.name: Pin Tuna
items.description:
A fish with a jaw covered
in tiny needle-like
spikes.

items.name: Rumblefish
items.description:
A fish that cracks
open when killed.

items.name: Scatterfish
items.description:
A fish that shatters
to pieces when killed.

items.name: Burst Arrowana
items.description:
A fish that ruptures
open when killed.

items.name: Bomb Arrowana
items.description:
A fish that explodes
when killed.

items.name: Glutton Tuna
items.description:
Will devour anything in
its path, and sometimes
these remain inside.

items.name: Gastronome Tuna
items.description:
An enormous Glutton Tuna.
Will eat anything, no
matter the size.

items.name: Speartuna
items.description:
A rare and valuable
giant-sized fish. What
could it be used for...?

items.name: Small Goldenfish
items.description:
A curiously small, rare,
gold fish. Commands a high
price.

items.name: Goldenfish
Silverfish
items.description:
A strange fish with a
silver body. Quite
valuable. (Account Item)

items.name: Ancient Fish
items.description:
A precious fish which can
be almost entirely used as
material.

items.name: Springnight Carp
items.description:
A species of carp whose
arrival signals the start
of breeding season.

items.name: Tailed Frog
items.description:
Rare frog that retained
its tail. This happens
under special conditions.

items.name: Insect Husk
items.description:
The remains of a dead
insect.

items.name: Yambug
items.description:
Yam-like bug that exudes a
scent that drives tuna
wild. Great fishing bait.

items.name: Bughopper
items.description:
An insect that exudes a
scent that drives arrowana
wild. Great fishing bait.

items.name: Snakebee Larva
items.description:
A snake-like larva with a
scent that Goldenfish just
love. Great fishing bait.

items.name: Godbug
items.description:
An insect said to live
for a thousand years.

items.name: Bitterbug
items.description:
Contains a bitter essence.
Has a 50% chance of curing
poison if consumed.

items.name: Flashbug
items.description:
An insect that emits
a powerful flash when
it dies.

items.name: Thunderbug
items.description:
An insect that emits
electricity when struck.
Has many applications.

items.name: Carpenterbug
items.description:
Viscous body fluids and
sharp jaws make this
insect an artisan.

items.name: King Scarab
items.description:
The royal class of the
scarabs, with a hard shell
and lustrous wings.

items.name: Emperor Cricket
items.description:
Exceptionally strong shell
makes it a good counter-
part to soft materials.

items.name: Killer Beetle
items.description:
Insect with a hard shell
and dazzling wings. Used
as an abrasive.

items.name: Hercudrome
items.description:
Said to be the world's
strongest bug. Widely used
in making equipment.

items.name: Rare Scarab
items.description:
A rare, prized insect.
Used to increase the power
of metal objects.

items.name: PhantomButterfly
items.description:
Rarely seen by humans,
its wings shimmer like
precious gems.

items.name: Royal Rhino
items.description:
Beetle with a jewel-like
shine and prized by
collectors. (Account Item)

items.name: Divine Rhino
items.description:
Beetle that glows as if
from the heavens. Loved by
collectors. (Account Item)

items.name: Rainbow Insect
items.description:
Beautiful insect material.
Colors and properties
depend on many variables.

items.name: Great Hornfly
items.description:
Insect with a giant horn,
massive shell, and wings
of butterfly-like beauty.

items.name: Great Ladybug
items.description:
Giant insect with a very
hard shell. Protects crops
by eating harmful pests.

items.name: Screamer
items.description:
A monster's internal
organ. If broken, it
emits a shrill sound.

items.name: Poison Sac
items.description:
A monster's internal
organ. Contains a
lethal poison.

items.name: Toxin Sac
items.description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with potent toxin.
Dangerous, even to touch.

items.name: DeadlyPoisonSac
items.description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with a most lethal
toxin. Use extreme care.

items.name: Paralysis Sac
items.description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with a paralyzing
neurotoxin.

items.name: Sleep Sac
items.description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with a powder that
causes sleep when inhaled.

items.name: Coma Sac
items.description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with a powder that
can induce a coma.

items.name: Flame Sac
items.description:
A monster's internal
organ. Contains a very
flammable powder.

items.name: Inferno Sac
items.description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with a powder that
ignites when touched.

items.name: Blazing Fire Sac
items.description:
A monster's internal organ
filled with an explosive
powder. Watch out!

items.name: Electro Sac
items.description:
The internal organ of a
Khezu. Releases
electricity if disturbed.

items.name: Thunder Sac
items.description:
The internal organ of a
Khezu. Contains unequaled
electrical energy.

items.name: Lightning Sac
items.description:
A monster's internal organ
charged with electricity &
the rumbling of thunder.

items.name: Power Extract
items.description:
Gypceros extract. The
secret to its ability to
run fast and far.

items.name: Pale Extract
items.description:
Khezu extract. Has the
ability to amplify the
effects of medicines.

items.name: Sm Monster Bone
items.description:
A very useful material,
indispensable for both
hunting and daily life.

items.name: Med Monster Bone
items.description:
Has more uses than
small bone. Usually
carved to make an item.

items.name: Lg Monster Bone
items.description:
Indispensable for crafting
one-piece items. Bone can
be connected to shell.

items.name: Monster Bone+
items.description:
Top quality monster bone.
Hard to find but a nearly
unbreakable material.

items.name: Hrd Monster Bone
items.description:
A monster's most unique
bone. Priceless strength,
but difficult to work.

items.name: Hvy Monster Bone
items.description:
Strong bone from only the
toughest of wyverns. It's
very thick and heavy.

items.name: Eldr Dragon Bone
items.description:
You can sense the elder
dragon's dignity from this
massive bone alone.

items.name: BigEDragonBone
items.description:
Top-notch bone from a
large dragon. Feels like
it could last forever.

items.name: Mystery Bone
items.description:
A well-worn bone.
Not sturdy enough
to use in combination.

items.name: Unknown Skull
items.description:
Animal skull. So worn
and weathered, it's
unidentifiable.

items.name: Master's Skull
items.description:
The remains of a top
hunter who once let his
guard down.

items.name: Bone
items.description:
Just a bone. So worn
and weathered, it's
unidentifiable.

items.name: RobustWyvernBone
items.description:
A bird wyvern's robust
bone. It's easy to work
with and is very durable.

items.name: Brute Bone
items.description:
The stout bone of a
brutish monster. An easy
to work material.

items.name: Giant Bone
items.description:
A fat, large bone. Can be
cut in the workshop to
make crafting material.

items.name: Stout Bone
items.description:
The stout, hard bone of a
brute. Rigid, it is
priceless for crafting.

items.name: Massive Bone
items.description:
Very hard bone from a very
large beast. Its worth as
material is beyond words.

items.name: Wyvern Fang
items.description:
Used for Bowgun munitions.
Combined with explosives,
it makes spreading shots.

items.name: Wyvern Claw
items.description:
Used for Bowgun munitions.
Combined with explosives,
it makes explosive shots.

items.name: Wyvern Stone
items.description:
A unique item formed by
the hardening of foreign
materials inside a wyvern.

items.name: Big Wyvern Stone
items.description:
A Wyvern Stone that's had
years upon years to form.
It has a mysterious glow.

items.name: BigEDragonJewel
items.description:
Ultra-rarely does a giant
stone like this form
inside an Elder Dragon.

items.name: White Liver
items.description:
A white liver, just as
stated. Its texture is
adored. (Account Item)

items.name: Popo Tongue
items.description:
A Popo tongue is popular,
healthy, and enjoyable to
eat. (Account Item)

items.name: Secret Pouch
items.description:
The pouch carried by a
Melynx. The insides are a
jumble. (Account Item)

items.name: CarapaceonBrains
items.description:
The brain matter of a
Carapaceon. A widely known
delicacy. (Account Item)

items.name: CarapaceonBrain+
items.description:
First-class Carapaceon
Brains. An Einsteinian
delicacy. (Account Item)

items.name: Piscine Liver
items.description:
Internal organ from a
Piscine Wyvern. A great
cure-all. (Account Item)

items.name: Wyvern Tears
items.description:
Precious tears wept only
on special occasions.
(Account Item)

items.name: Wyvern Sobs
items.description:
Precious crocodile tears
wept only on special
occasions. (Account Item)

items.name: Territorial Dung
items.description:
Droppings used by a
monster to mark territory.
(Account Item)

items.name: TerritorialDung+
items.description:
Large droppings used by a
monster to mark territory.
(Account Item)

items.name: Crab Pearl
items.description:
A jewel polished by time
inside a monster's body.
(Account Item)

items.name: Crab Pearl+
items.description:
A treasured jewel polished
by time inside a monster's
body. (Account Item)

items.name: Dragon Treasure
items.description:
Shining stones gathered
and loved by an elder
dragon. (Account Item)

items.name: Anc Drgn Treasre
items.description:
This stone's radiance
grows brighter as time
passes.(Account Item)

items.name: Decayed Drgn Scl
items.description:
Decays as time
relentlessly attacks its
surface. (Account Item)

items.name: Dragon Herb
items.description:
Crystallized Dragon Scale.
Priceless as a natural
medicine. (Account Item)

items.name: Felyne Fur Ruby
items.description:
Priceless ruby formed by
the rare hardening of a
Felyne hairball.

items.name: Mosswine Hide
items.description:
Mosswine hide.
It's covered in moss.

items.name: Bullfango Pelt
items.description:
Bullfango hide. It's
covered in bristly fur.

items.name: ThkBullfangoPelt
items.description:
High-grade Bullfango Pelt.
The fur is thick and of
superior quality.

items.name: Bullfango Head
items.description:
A Bullfango head with
a pair of huge fangs.

items.name: Bulldrome Tusk
items.description:
Majestic Bulldrome Tusk.
The damaged surface tells
the tale of many battles.

items.name: Bulldrome Hide
items.description:
A Bulldrome's bristly
hide. It is strangely
beautiful.

items.name: Bulldrome Hide+
items.description:
The tough hide of a
Bulldrome. It is
unblemished.

items.name: Kelbi Horn
items.description:
Infusions of powdered
Kelbi Horn are used
as medicine.

items.name: Kelbi Hide
items.description:
Used to join the plates
in a suit of armor and
to make winter clothing.

items.name: Anteka Antlers
items.description:
The horns of an Anteka.
Used in weapons, armor,
and interior decorating.

items.name: Anteka Pelt
items.description:
The soft, thick fur of an
Anteka. Provides
protection from cold.

items.name: High Qualty Pelt
items.description:
Feels excellent to the
touch. Difficult to carve
but valued by the Guild.

items.name: Remobra Skin
items.description:
The black skin of a wyvern
called a Remobra. Its
glossy surface sheens.

items.name: Remobra Skin+
items.description:
A high quality Remobra
skin. It has a vivid black
luster.

items.name: SpecRemobraSkin+
items.description:
Superior quality Remobra
skin. Its shines with a
Black Pearl-like luster.

items.name: Striped Skin
items.description:
The striped skin of a
Remobra. The black and red
stripes are very popular.

items.name: Remobra Skull
items.description:
Skull of a serpent-like
Remobra. Even in death its
fangs appear powerful.

items.name: ShakalakaTreasre
items.description:
Dropped by a Shakalaka in
a state of confusion.
Looks like trash...

items.name: ShakalakaTreasr+
items.description:
The rarest of the rare
things Shakalakas' drop,
their prized... garbage!?

items.name: ShakaInheritance
items.description:
Dropped by King Shakalaka.
It's the King's
splendid... garbage?

items.name: Giaprey Scale
items.description:
The color of this scale
allows you to approach in
the snow unseen.

items.name: Giaprey Scale+
items.description:
Scale ripped from a
Giaprey. Used to craft
excellent equipment.

items.name: Giaprey Hide
items.description:
Hide stripped of its
scales. Used to make
clothing for villagers.

items.name: Giaprey Hide+
items.description:
High quality Giaprey Hide.
A pathway to the creation
of sturdy equipment.

items.name: Giadrome Hide
items.description:
The hide of a Giadrome. It
bears the scars of a
leader's battles.

items.name: Giadrome Claw
items.description:
Sharper than a Giaprey
claw, touching it bare-
handed is quite dangerous.

items.name: Giadrome Claw+
items.description:
A sharp Giadrome Claw. The
deadly weapon of a
Giadrome pack leader.

items.name: Giadrome Skull
items.description:
The large crest on this
Giadrome skull denotes
it as a pack leader.

items.name: Velociprey Fang
items.description:
Sharp (though not as
sharp as a wyvern fang).
Used to make Bowgun ammo.

items.name: Velociprey Scale
items.description:
Scale obtained by carving
up a Velociprey.
Blue and black in color.

items.name: Velociprey Scle+
items.description:
Scale stripped from a
Velociprey. It can be made
into light, durable armor.

items.name: Velociprey Hide
items.description:
Hide stripped of its
scales. Used to join the
plates in a suit of armor.

items.name: Velociprey Hide+
items.description:
The high quality, descaled
hide of a Velociprey, it
has many applications.

items.name: Velocidrome Hide
items.description:
The hide of a Velociprey
leader. It bears the scars
of a leadership role.

items.name: Velocidrome Claw
items.description:
Claw from an alpha
Velociprey. Sharp and
blade-like.

items.name: Velocidrome Clw+
items.description:
The sharp claw of a
Velocidrome. It can easily
slice through prey.

items.name: Velocidrome Head
items.description:
Large head with a crest.
You'd look pretty fierce
if you put it on.

items.name: Genprey Fang
items.description:
Poisonous fang from a
Genprey. Paralyzing toxin
even works on wyverns.

items.name: Genprey Scale
items.description:
Scale from a Genprey.
Acts as camouflage in the
desert zone.

items.name: Genprey Scale+
items.description:
Scale taken from a
Genprey. Strong enough to
repel a wyvern's fangs.

items.name: Genprey Hide
items.description:
A hide with all the scales
removed. Can be tanned at
the fort.

items.name: Genprey Hide+
items.description:
The high quality, descaled
hide of a Genprey, it can
neutralize neurotoxins.

items.name: Gendrome Hide
items.description:
Sturdy green hide from
a Gendrome. Perfect for
making strong armor.

items.name: Gendrome Tail
items.description:
This flexible tail has
adapted to the harsh
conditions of the desert.

items.name: Gendrome Skull
items.description:
The skull of a Gendrome is
noted for its two crests.

items.name: Ioprey Fang
items.description:
Fang filled with deadly
poison. Care is required
when handling it.

items.name: Ioprey Scale
items.description:
The dangerous poison
normally in the scale
has been removed.

items.name: Ioprey Scale+
items.description:
Scale stripped from an
Ioprey. Can be used, once
the poison is removed.

items.name: Ioprey Hide
items.description:
Descaled hide, often made
into belts. Red belts are
used in decorations.

items.name: Ioprey Hide+
items.description:
High quality, descaled
hide of an Ioprey, the
red skin resists poison.

items.name: Iodrome Hide
items.description:
Sturdy red hide from
an Iodrome. Perfect for
making strong armor.

items.name: Iodrome Skull
items.description:
The large crest on an
Iodrome's skull is enough
to catch the eyes of all.

items.name: OrangeHypnoPelt
items.description:
Vibrant orange pelt of a
Hypnocatrice. It's great
for making strong leather.

items.name: OrangeHypnoPelt+
items.description:
Thick and vibrant orange
fur. It's a very valuable
crafting material.

items.name: Top-GrdHypnoClaw
items.description:
Very sharp and rigid high-
quality claw. The shine is
proof of its quality.

items.name: Hypno Claw+
items.description:
Hypnocatrice's hard claw.
One kick with this on,
and your prey is done.

items.name: Hypno Bezoar
items.description:
Helps the Hypnocatrice
digest its food. It's
transparent, yet shines.

items.name: Hypno Bezoar+
items.description:
Noblewomen's desire, this
stone is very pure and
has a beautiful shape.

items.name: Hypno Beak
items.description:
Complex-shaped beak. Its
unique shape is popular
in some hunting circles.

items.name: Hypno Fang
items.description:
This beak looks like a
fang. Its hardness is
good for combining.

items.name: RainbowTailFeath
items.description:
Light-refracting tail
feather. Used in jewelry,
young women love this.

items.name: Hypno Ticket
items.description:
Stamped proof of hunting a
Hypnocatrice and finishing
a hard quest.

items.name: Kut-Ku Scale
items.description:
Pink colored scale from a
Kut-Ku. Fire-resistant.
Can be found in the field.

items.name: Kut-Ku Scale+
items.description:
Superior scale from a Kut-
Ku. Its size and weight
are a cut above.

items.name: Thick Kut-Ku Scl
items.description:
The pinnacle of Kut-Ku
scales. Very few scales
mature to this degree.

items.name: Kut-Ku Shell
items.description:
The Fire resistant shell
of a Kut-Ku. Quite
resistant to Fire.

items.name: Kut-Ku Carapace
items.description:
Harder than Kut-Ku Shell,
this material is also
known as Gravite.

items.name: Hvy Kut-Ku Shell
items.description:
Stout outer shell, harder
than a Kut-Ku Carapace.
Also known as Mediastinum.

items.name: Kut-Ku Ear
items.description:
The Fire resistant ear of
a Kut-Ku. Used to prevent
Bowgun flash-back.

items.name: Long Kut-Ku Ear
items.description:
Kut-Ku's Fire resistant
ear. The flexible material
is a good base for armor.

items.name: Lucky Kut-Ku Ear
items.description:
Highly-specialized ear.
Lots of flesh and good
texture makes it "lucky".

items.name: Giant Beak
items.description:
The huge, sturdy beak
of a Yian Kut-Ku.

items.name: Splendid Beak
items.description:
Finding a large, beautiful
beak in this shape is
quite rare! Splendid!

items.name: Kut-Ku Webbing
items.description:
Webbing from a Kut-Ku
wing. Better as a fusing
material than animal skin.

items.name: Str Kut-Ku Wing
items.description:
Top-grade Kut-Ku wing.
Stout, expansive, and
fire resistant material.

items.name: Blue Kut-Ku Scl
items.description:
Scale of the extremely
rare Blue Kut-Ku. Makes
vivid blue armor.

items.name: Blue Kut-Ku Scl+
items.description:
Superior scale from a Blue
Yian Kut-Ku. Its complex
color is infinitely cool.

items.name: ThkBlueKut-KuScl
items.description:
Super thick Blue Kut-Ku
scale. As blue as the
ocean, it's a work of art.

items.name: Blue Kut-Ku Shl
items.description:
Shell of a rare Blue
Kut-Ku. The vivid blue
makes it a popular item.

items.name: Blue Kut-Ku Cpc
items.description:
Rare Blue Kut-Ku Carapace.
Harder than its shell,
often used in crafting.

items.name: HvyBlueKut-KuShl
items.description:
Outer shell even thicker
than Blue Kut-Ku Cpc.
Crafters long for this.

items.name: Rubbery Hide
items.description:
Highly elastic Gypceros
hide. A good insulator,
resistant to electricity.

items.name: Rubbery Hide+
items.description:
High quality, highly
elastic Gypceros hide.
Gives off a strange scent.

items.name: SpecRubberyHide+
items.description:
Special quality, highly
elastic Gypceros hide.
Absorbs all attacks.

items.name: Gypceros Head
items.description:
The uniquely shaped head
of a Gypceros. A must have
for Gypceros lovers!

items.name: HardGypcerosHead
items.description:
Hard rubber-like head of
a Gyperos. A must for
all Gypceros lovers!

items.name: Pur Rubbery Hide
items.description:
A rarely seen Purple
Gypceros hide. The chic
purple hide is en vogue.

items.name: Pur Gypceros Wng
items.description:
A seldom seen purple wing
from a Gypceros.
Incredibly valuable.

items.name: HrdPuGypcerosWng
items.description:
Top-grade purple Gypceros
wing. Poison-resistant, it
makes for good protection.

items.name: Garuga Scale
items.description:
Scale carved from Yian
Garuga. It shines an
ominous purple.

items.name: Garuga Scale+
items.description:
Superior Garuga scale.
Looks like a Kut-Ku scale,
but it's much tougher.

items.name: ThickGarugaScale
items.description:
Top-grade Garuga scale.
Sparkles like purple
quartz and just as hard.

items.name: Garuga Shell
items.description:
A rare material admired
and the subject of much
research.

items.name: Garuga Carapace
items.description:
Garuga Shell that's become
stronger with time. Great
skill is needed to work.

items.name: Hvy Garuga Shell
items.description:
Heavy, dark purple outer
shell with an unusually
intimidating air about it.

items.name: Garuga Ear
items.description:
Its shape and form shows a
different evolutionary
path than Yian Kut-Ku.

items.name: Long Garuga Ear
items.description:
Well-developed Garuga Ear.
Worn as armor, it's said
to heighten one's senses.

items.name: Sharpened Beak
items.description:
The sharpened beak of Yian
Garuga. Compared to a Kut-
Ku, it's much deadlier.

items.name: Rejuvenated Beak
items.description:
Garuga beak. Its color,
luster, and the jawline's
angle have been restored.

items.name: Garuga Wing
items.description:
A first class material
that requires high
crafting technology.

items.name: Str Garuga Wing
items.description:
Large and well-developed
Garuga Wing. Prized among
crafters.

items.name: Garuga Tail
items.description:
Has a special function
that responds to shocks
with a powerful venom.

items.name: LethrGarugaTail
items.description:
Leathery tail outfitted
with deadly poison meant
to kill its target.

items.name: Garuga Mane
items.description:
A sense of coercion fills
the air. This mane is no
simple decoration.

items.name: SilverGarugaPelt
items.description:
Shimmering silver pelt
that mesmerizes with its
beauty when it flutters.

items.name: Blango Pelt
items.description:
Snow white Blango Pelt. It
protects the body against
the mountain cold.

items.name: Blango Pelt+
items.description:
Harder to work than normal
Blango Pelt, this has high
value as a material.

items.name: Sharp Claw
items.description:
A shining black claw.
Unlike wyvern claws, this
is shaped to grip objects.

items.name: Piercing Claw
items.description:
Dangerous to touch with
bare hands, it's used as
a knife in some workshops.

items.name: Blangonga Fang
items.description:
The fang of the killer
Blangonga. As sharp and
deadly as a dagger.

items.name: Blangonga Fang+
items.description:
A Blangonga bicuspid. As
large as a human thigh, it
has potential as a weapon.

items.name: HvyBlangongaFang
items.description:
Giant Blangonga Fang. Can
make shish kabobs out of
even medium-sized beasts.

items.name: Blangonga Pelt
items.description:
White fur with astounding
thermal properties and as
strong as an iron chain.

items.name: Blangonga Pelt+
items.description:
The hardened pelt of a
Blangonga. The needle-like
hairs are prized material.

items.name: HrdBlangongaPlt+
items.description:
Very hard Blangonga pelt.
Made tough by the arctic
winds. 100% natural armor.

items.name: Blangonga Whiskr
items.description:
Large whiskers on the head
denote the alpha leader
of a group of Blangos.

items.name: Lthr Pelagus Plt
items.description:
Especially tough Pelagus
pelt. You can tell its
owner was an aged leader.

items.name: Blangonga Tail
items.description:
The smooth feeling of a
Blangonga Tail is
undeniably appealing.

items.name: LeathrBlangoTail
items.description:
Leathery Blangonga tail.
Soft-as-snow fur makes it
prized crafting material.

items.name: C.BlangongaPelt+
items.description:
Copper Blangonga pelt.
It's harder due to the
harsh desert environment.

items.name: HvyC.BlangoFang
items.description:
Extremely sharp, big fang
infused with the strength
of desert survival.

items.name: LthrC.BlangoTail
items.description:
Leathery tail of a rich
copper color and as hard
as a boulder.

items.name: Conga Pelt
items.description:
Conga fur. Its solid feel
makes it a good material.

items.name: Conga Pelt+
items.description:
The hard pelt of a Conga.
The thick fur makes
long-lasting equipment.

items.name: Congalala Pelt
items.description:
Pink fur of a Congalala.
The tufts of hair are
often used in clothing.

items.name: Congalala Pelt+
items.description:
The stout hairs of this
pelt are important tools
in crafting equipment.

items.name: HrdCongalalaPlt+
items.description:
The even stouter hairs of
this pelt and its glossy
coat make it perfect.

items.name: Vibrant Pelt
items.description:
Vibrant hair that grows on
the head of a Congalala.
The colors are lovely.

items.name: Congalala Claw
items.description:
A Congalala Claw. Large
and sharp, it has a black
luster.

items.name: Congalala Claw+
items.description:
A long, hard, sharp claw
with a wild nature that
makes crafting difficult.

items.name: HrdCongalalaClw+
items.description:
Specially developed for
fighting. It's so sharp,
it's a natural weapon.

items.name: Congalala Fang
items.description:
The fang of a Congalala is
solid enough to crunch
objects into dust.

items.name: Lg Pelagus Fang
items.description:
Large Pelagus fang that
can bite through even the
hardest of boulders.

items.name: E.CongalalaPelt+
items.description:
Emerald fur, but the color
difference isn't all. It
boasts better quality too.

items.name: HrdE.CongaClaw
items.description:
Emerald Congalala claw.
So hard it could pulverize
a giant tree to dust.

items.name: Vibrant Comb
items.description:
An Emerald Congalala's
comb. Proof of a leader.
Splendid and vivid color.

items.name: Rajang Horn
items.description:
Majestic gold horn of a
Rajang. Hunters yearn for
the heroism it represents.

items.name: Hard Rajang Horn
items.description:
Majestic large gold horn.
All who see it feel the
bravery of the hunter.

items.name: Rajang Fang
items.description:
This sharpened fang can
cut through anything dumb
enough to touch it.

items.name: Hvy Rajang Fang
items.description:
Fang that can cut through
anything. Once caught, the
prey's life vanishes.

items.name: Blk Rajang Pelt
items.description:
Black Rajang fur. When
crafted, the fabric is
desired even by royalty.

items.name: Blk Rajang Pelt+
items.description:
When made into armor, this
strong and leathery pelt
gives a sense of security.

items.name: Rajang Claw
items.description:
A sharp Rajang Claw.
Difficult to carve and
more difficult to craft.

items.name: Hard Rajang Claw
items.description:
A hard Rajang claw that
has taken many lives in a
most brutal fashion.

items.name: Rajang Tail
items.description:
The glistening tail of a
Rajang. The gold fur is
beautiful and elegant.

items.name: Gold Rajang Pelt
items.description:
The fur of a Rajang's
body. The gold hair is
treasured by tailors.

items.name: GoldRajangPelt+
items.description:
Shimmering golden pelt.
It shines with the furious
power of a Rajang's anger.

items.name: Piscine Fang
items.description:
Fang from a Plesioth
or Cephalos. Used
to hold and kill prey.

items.name: HvyPiscineFang
items.description:
Heavy Piscine fang that
can bite through even
large shelled creatures.

items.name: Plesioth Scale
items.description:
An incandescent scale
from a Plesioth. Becomes
brittle if it dries out.

items.name: Plesioth Scale+
items.description:
A faintly shining scale
from a Plesioth. It keeps
shining even when dry.

items.name: ThckPlesiothScl
items.description:
Brilliant Plesioth scale.
So thick that neither fang
nor claw can penetrate.

items.name: Plesioth Fin
items.description:
A beautiful fin from a
Plesioth. The spikes
are stunningly poisonous.

items.name: Plesioth Fin+
items.description:
Beautiful, high quality
fin. Its thorns are filled
with a strong neurotoxin.

items.name: SpecPlesiothFin+
items.description:
Top-quality material, and
the most beautiful of
Plesioth fins available.

items.name: Grn Plesioth Scl
items.description:
Scale of a mysterious
Green Plesioth. It has a
emerald-like glow.

items.name: Grn Plsioth Scl+
items.description:
A high quality scale from
a Green Plesioth. The
color is eye-catching.

items.name: ThckGrnPlesioScl
items.description:
Top-grade, thick green
scale. Specialized armor
can be made from this.

items.name: Grn Plesioth Fin
items.description:
A beautiful fin from a
Green Plesioth. Often used
in decoration.

items.name: Grn Plsioth Fin+
items.description:
A high quality fin from a
Green Plesioth. Easy to
work, it is widely used.

items.name: SpecGrnPlesioFn+
items.description:
Top-quality green fin used
in decoration crafting.
Adds a sparkle to armor.

items.name: Cephalos Scale
items.description:
A sand wyvern scale. Its
color is a brilliant blue.
Retains moisture.

items.name: Cephalos Scale+
items.description:
High quality sand wyvern
scale. Its color is a
stunning blue.

items.name: Cephalos Fin
items.description:
A sand wyvern fin. It
isn't poisonous, but it's
very sharp.

items.name: Cephalos Fin+
items.description:
A high quality fin from a
Cephalos. Sharper than
the normal version.

items.name: Coral Cphlos Scl
items.description:
A coral sand wyvern
scale. The vivid purple is
popular with hunters.

items.name: Coral Cphlos Fin
items.description:
A coral sand wyvern fin.
The faint pink color is
quite cute.

items.name: ThckLavasiothScl
items.description:
Thick Lavasioth scale.
Under the encrusted lava
lies a golden treasure.

items.name: HvyLavasiothShl
items.description:
Heavy scale that covers
its body, Cooled lava
adds to the armor.

items.name: HvyLavasiothFang
items.description:
Heavy and specialized fang
that's so big, it barely
looks like a Piscine's.

items.name: SpecLavasioFin+
items.description:
Top-grade Lavasioth fin.
Forged in magma, it has an
extremely sharp edge.

items.name: Lavasioth Ticket
items.description:
Stamped proof of hunting a
Lavasioth and finishing a
hard quest.

items.name: Wyvern Skull Shl
items.description:
A Carapaceon shell made
from a wyvern's skull.

items.name: Sm Hermitaur Shl
items.description:
Piece of bone from a giant
Carapaceon. Small, so it
is limited in its uses.

items.name: Hermitaur Shell
items.description:
This stratified Daimyo
shell is lighter than it
appears and easy to craft.

items.name: Hermitaur Carpce
items.description:
The hard carapace of a
Daimyo Hermitaur. Harder
than shell to work.

items.name: HvyHermitaurShl
items.description:
A Daimyo Hemitaur's strong
bone shell. Its thickness
makes for strong armor.

items.name: Hermitaur Claw
items.description:
Giant claw from a Daimyo
Hermitaur. The sharp claw
can slice through rock.

items.name: Hermitaur Claw+
items.description:
Sharp claw from a Daimyo
Hermitaur. It is said to
be as hard as metal.

items.name: HrdHermitaurClaw
items.description:
Hard claw from a Daimyo
Hermitaur. Holds up like a
fort against assaults.

items.name: PlumD.HermitrShl
items.description:
A rich and deep purple
giant shell. It makes for
strong and colorful armor.

items.name: PlumD.HermitrClw
items.description:
A rich and deep purple
hard claw. It makes for
strong and colorful armor.

items.name: Sm Ceanataur Shl
items.description:
Piece of a giant Ceanataur
Shell. Lighter than it
looks and easy to craft.

items.name: Ceanataur Shell
items.description:
A giant Shogun Ceanataur
Shell. Has a distinctive
color and shape.

items.name: Ceanataur Carpce
items.description:
Harder than a Ceanataur
Shell, this carapace is
harder to work with.

items.name: HvyCeanataurShl
items.description:
Heavier than a Ceanataur
Carpce. Top-grade material
needs an expert crafter.

items.name: Ceanataur Leg
items.description:
Leg of a Shogun Ceanataur.
Incredibly strong to be
able to move a huge body.

items.name: HvyCeanataurLeg
items.description:
Heavy leg of a Shogun
Ceanataur. It's wanted for
its thickness and shape.

items.name: Ceanataur Pincer
items.description:
Seeing a Shogun's pincer
blade causes even the
bravest hunters to flinch.

items.name: Ceanataur Claw
items.description:
A giant Shogun Ceanataur
Claw. Those who fall in
its path pay the price.

items.name: Ceanataur Claw+
items.description:
The sharp claw of a giant
Shogun Ceanataur. It is a
true menace to hunters.

items.name: HrdCeanataurClaw
items.description:
Hard-as-rock Shogun claw.
Choice material for
the best equipment.

items.name: TerraCeanatrShl
items.description:
New, sublime equipment can
be crafted from this giant
earth-colored shell.

items.name: TerraCeanatrClaw
items.description:
Giant earth-colored claw,
that many have succumbed
to. Makes great weapons.

items.name: Sm Lobstershell
items.description:
The cranial shell of a
King Lobster that was
used as bait. Very rare.

items.name: Lg Lobstershell
items.description:
The body shell of a King
Lobster that was used as
bait. Very rare.

items.name: Gt Lobstershell
items.description:
The very large body shell
of a King Lobster that was
used as bait. Very rare.

items.name: Rathian Scale
items.description:
A scale from a Rathian.
Its focus is her nest. Its
mate is a male Rathalos.

items.name: Rathian Scale+
items.description:
The scale of a Rathian. It
appears to be normal,
but its stiffness is not.

items.name: ThckRathianScl
items.description:
Especially thick Rathian
scale. Its age shows the
longevity of its owner.

items.name: Rathian Plate
items.description:
A fiery scale from the
tail of a Rathian.

items.name: Rathian Ruby
items.description:
A rare, precious gem from
inside a wyvern. Almost
too nice to use.

items.name: HvnlyRathianScl
items.description:
A phantasmal scale. When
crafted, said to unify the
earth and seize the sky.

items.name: Rathian Shell
items.description:
Shell from a Rathian,
comprised of numerous
scales. Very hard.

items.name: Rathian Carapace
items.description:
Harder than a Rathian
Shell, this material is
also known as Gravite.

items.name: HvyRathianShell
items.description:
Shell heavier than a
Carapace. Used whenever
reinforcement is required.

items.name: Rathian Spike
items.description:
Spike-like hair from
the back and wings of a
Rathian. Poisonous.

items.name: Rathian Spike+
items.description:
A hair from a Rathian,
even stronger than a
sword. Longer than normal.

items.name: Rathian Thorn
items.description:
Spike-like hair that
covers a Rathian. Highly
poisonous and very sharp.

items.name: Pnk Rathian Scl
items.description:
Scale from a Pink
Rathian, that resembles a
dream-like flower petal.

items.name: Pnk Rathian Scl+
items.description:
Scale from a Pink Rathian.
The color masks its true
strength.

items.name: ThckPnkRathnScl
items.description:
Beautiful, sparkling scale
from a Pink Rathian. Few
crafters have seen one.

items.name: Pnk Rathian Shl
items.description:
Shell from a Pink Rathian.
It hardened during
adolescence.

items.name: Pnk Rathian Cpc
items.description:
Harder than Pink Rathian
Shell. Its beautiful color
is often used in armor.

items.name: HvyPnkRathianShl
items.description:
Heavy outer shell. Beauty
so great that just one
demands a high price.

items.name: Gld Rathian Scl+
items.description:
Scale carved from the body
of a Gold Rathian.
Brilliant, even at night.

items.name: ThckGldRathnScl
items.description:
Thick gold scale. Bright
as the sun, almost holy,
it's unlike any other.

items.name: Gld Rathian Cpc
items.description:
A hard shell covered in
shining gold scales. As
gorgeous as a gold bar.

items.name: HvyGldRathianShl
items.description:
Heavy golden shell that
shines brighter than gold.
Takes the breath away.

items.name: GoldRathianThorn
items.description:
Golden spike-like hair
that is extremely sharp
and poisonous.

items.name: Fire Wyvern Claw
items.description:
Claw that grows on the
wing of a fire wyvern. Can
be cut off in battle.

items.name: HrdFireWyvernClw
items.description:
A fire wyvern's hard wing
claw. So hard & sharp that
even rocks are like paper.

items.name: FireWyvern Fluid
items.description:
Heat producing body fluids
from a fire wyvern. Useful
in equipment crafting.

items.name: FireWyvrn Marrow
items.description:
A material obtained via
new carving techniques.
Highly combustible.

items.name: FireWyvrn BrnStm
items.description:
The latest material to be
removed with technology.
Difficult to process.

items.name: Rathalos Scale
items.description:
A scale from a Rathalos.
Wyvern scales and shells
are basic crafting items.

items.name: Rathalos Scale+
items.description:
A scale from a Rathalos,
it is extraordinarily
strong.

items.name: Hrd Rathalos Scl
items.description:
Thicker and heavier than
most wyvern scales. A
natural treasure.

items.name: Rathalos Plate
items.description:
A fiery scale from the
tail of a Rathalos.

items.name: Rathalos Ruby
items.description:
A precious gem from inside
a wyvern. Sending it to be
processed is excruciating.

items.name: HvnlyRathalosScl
items.description:
A phantasmal scale. When
crafted, said to unify the
earth and seize the sky.

items.name: Rathalos Shell
items.description:
Shell from a Rathalos,
comprised of numerous
scales. Very hard.

items.name: Rathalos Carpace
items.description:
Harder than a Rathalos
shell, this material is
also known as Gravite.

items.name: HvyRathalosShl
items.description:
Harder than a Rathalos
Carpace, it's also known
as Mediastinum.

items.name: Rathalos Tail
items.description:
The tail of a Rathalos.
A multi-purpose item.

items.name: LthrRathalosTail
items.description:
Top-grade Rathalos tail.
The treasured leather is
only used in select armor.

items.name: Rathalos Webbing
items.description:
This heat-resistant
material is often
used as armor lining.

items.name: Rathalos Wing
items.description:
A valuable item. Used by
smiths at the armory to
make powerful equipment.

items.name: StrRathalosWing
items.description:
Top-grade Rathalos wing.
The fine cut is worthy of
the Sky King himself.

items.name: Azure Rthlos Scl
items.description:
The scale of an Azure
Rathalos. It is the deep
blue of the night sky.

items.name: Azre Rthlos Scl+
items.description:
Scale of an Azure
Rathalos. Its strength is
higher than its beauty.

items.name: ThckAzurRthlsScl
items.description:
Layered smaller scales
make this thick scale
beautiful and strong.

items.name: Azure Rthlos Shl
items.description:
The shell of an Azure
Rathalos. Made of scales
hardened at adolescence.

items.name: Azure Rthlos Cpc
items.description:
Harder than an Azure
Rathalos Shell. Its beauty
is desirable for armor.

items.name: HvyAzurRthlsShl
items.description:
Azure Rathalos Shell
thicker than anything seen
before. Ultra-rare.

items.name: Azur Rthlos Tail
items.description:
Severed tail of an Azure
Rathalos. Its rarity and
high value are linked.

items.name: LthrAzrRthlsTail
items.description:
Top-quality tail. The
especially strong leather
is beyond valuable.

items.name: Azur Rthlos Wing
items.description:
Wing shed by an Azure
Rathalos. Used to make
both weapons and armor.

items.name: Slvr Rthlos Scl+
items.description:
Quality scale carved from
the Silver Rathalos. It
has a moon-like shine.

items.name: ThckSlvrRthlsScl
items.description:
Layered smaller scales
make up this thick scale.
Oft used in jewels.

items.name: Slvr Rthlos Cpc
items.description:
The silver scales of this
hard Silver Rathalos
Carapace have a icy shine.

items.name: HvySlvrRthlsShl
items.description:
Heavy shell that shines
like the moon in the
darkness. Mythical item.

items.name: Slvr Rthlos Tail
items.description:
Severed tail of a Silver
Rathalos. Its rarity and
high value are linked.

items.name: LthrSlvrRthlsTal
items.description:
Top-grade tail. Its beauty
is worth its weight in
silver times a thousand.

items.name: Slvr Rthlos Wing
items.description:
Wing shed by a Silver
Rathalos. Hunters long for
its shining glory.

items.name: Flabby Hide
items.description:
Workable as a material
after recent advances. Has
mysterious properties.

items.name: Khezu Hide - Tan
items.description:
The tanned hide of a
Khezu. Its strange
properties are a mystery.

items.name: KhezuHide-Cream
items.description:
Top-quality Khezu hide.
Its glossy luster
mesmerizes all who see it.

items.name: Pale Bone
items.description:
Rib bone from a Khezu
with meat still attached.

items.name: Pale Khezu Steak
items.description:
Fatty red meat from a
Pale Khezu. Looks tasty,
but cannot be eaten.

items.name: KhezuSpecialCut
items.description:
Supreme quality cut among
all that red Khezu flesh.
Not especially tasty...

items.name: Alluring Hide
items.description:
Red Khezu hide polished to
a luster. Just looking at
it makes you feel strange.

items.name: Alluring Webbing
items.description:
Hard to craft but highly
useful, its multi-colored
hues are treasured.

items.name: StrAlluringWing
items.description:
Alluring top-grade Red
Khezu wing. Flexible but
strong. Very valuable.

items.name: Basarios Shell
items.description:
Shell from a Basarios.
Rock-like consistency.
Can be forged into metal.

items.name: Basarios Carpace
items.description:
Harder than a Basarios
shell, this material is
also known as Gravite.

items.name: HvyBasariosShell
items.description:
Heavy shell encrusted with
some quality Ore. Mimics
a stone wall very well.

items.name: Basarios Wing
items.description:
The wing of a Basarios.
Very hard to work as a
material.

items.name: StrBasariosWing
items.description:
Top-grade Basarios wing.
Not great for flying, but
beyond great as material.

items.name: Basarios Tears
items.description:
Faintly pink gems found
near the tear ducts of a
Basarios.

items.name: Tigrex Scale
items.description:
Scale from the incredibly
violent Tigrex. Incredibly
massive and sturdy.

items.name: Tigrex Scale+
items.description:
A flawless Tigrex scale.
When interlocked, they can
be harder than steel.

items.name: ThickTigrexScale
items.description:
Thick Tigrex Scale. Able
to resist the desert heat
and the mountain cold.

items.name: HvnlyTigrexScale
items.description:
A phantasmal scale. When
crafted, said to unify the
earth and seize the sky.

items.name: Tigrex Shell
items.description:
A hard Tigrex shell
capable of repelling any
impact. Extreme tenacity.

items.name: Tigrex Carapace
items.description:
Hardened by the sands of
time. Its edges indicate a
Tigrex's ferocity.

items.name: Hvy Tigrex Shell
items.description:
Heavy Tigrex shell. Able
to withstand the toughest
nature has to offer.

items.name: Tigrex Tail
items.description:
This flexible and strong
tail can make great
equipment.

items.name: LeathrTigrexTail
items.description:
The violent Tigrex's top-
grade tail. Hard to work,
and requires great skill.

items.name: Tigrex Claw
items.description:
A distinctive forelimb
claw unseen on other
wyverns. Fiendishly sharp.

items.name: Tigrex Claw+
items.description:
Sharpened by the sands of
time. Said to be sharpened
by the deaths of others.

items.name: Hard Tigrex Claw
items.description:
Super tough Tigrex claw.
It has dug into much flesh
and spilled much blood.

items.name: Tigrex Fang
items.description:
No one can hide their fear
of this terrible fang
sharpened by pain itself.

items.name: Tigrex Fang+
items.description:
The sharp fang of a
Tigrex. These fangs can
cut any prey to shreds.

items.name: Hvy Tigrex Fang
items.description:
Thick, large Tigrex fang
used to tear its prey into
pieces.

items.name: Tigrex Skull Shl
items.description:
The skull of the violent
Tigrex. Just as dreadful
as the living version.

items.name: Narga Scale+
items.description:
Top-quality black scale.
It's surprisingly light,
yet stiff and smooth.

items.name: ThickNargaScale
items.description:
Top-grade thick black
scale. Still light, but
stronger with thickness.

items.name: HvnlyNargaScale
items.description:
A phantasmal scale. When
crafted, said to unify the
earth and seize the sky.

items.name: Black Narga Pelt
items.description:
Black fur that grows on
scales. Covers the animal
in jet-black darkness.

items.name: BlackNargaPelt+
items.description:
Highly-developed black
fur. Glossy and strong, it
protects against attacks.

items.name: Nargacuga Tail
items.description:
A weapon of the Nargacuga,
it looks the part and has
the power to prove it.

items.name: LeatherNargaTail
items.description:
Top-grade Nargacuga tail.
Ideal material with
delicacy and strength.

items.name: Narga Tail Spike
items.description:
Spike-shaped scale from a
Nargacuga's tail. Blood
flow doubles when angered.

items.name: HvyNargaTailSpik
items.description:
Top-quality tail spike.
Heavy and sharp, it
is deadlier than most.

items.name: NargaCuttingWing
items.description:
Blade-like Nargacuga wing.
Evolved to cut prey down
on the fly.

items.name: StrNargaCttngWng
items.description:
Stronger cutting wing.
Cuts prey in two with even
greater ease on the fly.

items.name: Nargacuga Fang+
items.description:
Extraordinarily sharp,
this fang has evolved more
for tearing than chewing.

items.name: HvyNargacugaFang
items.description:
Developed, sharp Nargacuga
fang. Slices through prey
like pie.

items.name: Narga Brain Stem
items.description:
The brainstem, while hard
to work with, is easily
the most valuable of all.

items.name: Gravios Shell
items.description:
The stone-like shell
of a Gravios. May
contain traces of ore.

items.name: Gravios Carapace
items.description:
Harder than Gravios Shell,
this material is known as
Gravite.

items.name: HvyGraviosShell
items.description:
Stout outer shell, heavier
than a Gravios Carapace.
Also known as Mediastinum.

items.name: HvnlyGraviosShl
items.description:

Cap crafted from Blangonga
materials. Wearing it will
sharpen a sniper's mind.

helmet.name: Monoblos Helm X
helmet.description:
A helm that recalls a man's
fear of Monoblos. Those who
wear it are truly heroes.

helmet.name: Monoblos Cap X
helmet.description:
Cap made from Monoblos
material. Incredibly thick
and imposing armor.

helmet.name: Ceanataur Helm X
helmet.description:
Made from Shogun Ceanataur
materials. Protection sharp
enough to cut steel.

helmet.name: Ceanataur Cap X
helmet.description:
Made from Shogun Ceanataur
materials. The hard shell is
fully exploited in crafting.

helmet.name: Rathian Helm X
helmet.description:
Splendid, strong, graced
with a Rathian's dignity.
Both beautiful and fearsome.

helmet.name: Rathian Cap X
helmet.description:
A cap that lives up to its
Queen's name. A work of art
forged in scorching flames.

helmet.name: Rathalos Helm X
helmet.description:
For a hunter, this rare helm
is almost like a crown.
Boasts overwhelming Defense.

helmet.name: Rathalos Cap X
helmet.description:
You'll look like the top
hunter with this on your
head. Best Gunner armor.

helmet.name: Narga Helm X
helmet.description:
This resembles a Nargacuga's
haunting, glowing eyes,
peering from the darkness.

helmet.name: Narga Cap X
helmet.description:
Cap as dark as the night.
Gives off the aura of some-
thing slicing in the dark.

helmet.name: Diablo Helm X
helmet.description:
Helm that carries a Diablos'
symbol - its horn. Proves
one to be a desert champion.

helmet.name: Diablo Cap X
helmet.description:
Worn by those courageous few
who have defeated Diablos. A
veritable fashion statement.

helmet.name: Gravios Helm X
helmet.description:
Helm cast from Gravios
materials, this rock-like
armor deflects attacks.

helmet.name: Gravios Cap X
helmet.description:
Cap made from Gravios
materials. Simply wearing it
is proof of one's valor.

helmet.name: Empress Crown X
helmet.description:
Crown of the fire empress
Lunastra. Special crafting
traps her blue flaming soul.

helmet.name: Empress Mask X
helmet.description:
Mask crafted from Lunastra
materials. The head ornament
flickers with blue flames.

helmet.name: Dragonhead X
helmet.description:
Recalls the howl of Fatalis,
and even its user may die
from the fright of memories.

helmet.name: Dragonface X
helmet.description:
Strength beyond the bounds
of mortals. The death knell
of Fatalis still echoes.

helmet.name: Dark Ukanlos Mask
helmet.description:
The white god will call
forth the day of reckoning,
but this can keep you safe.

helmet.name: Dark Ukanlos Fangs
helmet.description:
The white god can demolish
the planet. One breath
causes a snowstorm.

helmet.name: Hypno Helm
helmet.description:
Intimidating helm made of
Hypnocatrice materials. It
looks like the bird itself.

helmet.name: Hypno Cap
helmet.description:
Cap made of Hypnocatrice
materials. Its color scheme
makes hunters feel brave.

helmet.name: Lava Helm
helmet.description:
Helm made of Lavasioth
materials. The petrified
parts are strong, yet light.

helmet.name: Lava Cap
helmet.description:
The Lavasioth, with light,
igneous stone and strong,
leather scales, is the base.

helmet.name: Ambitious Piercing
helmet.description:
Ear piercing that goes with
anything. It's said to
reflect the person's heart.

helmet.name: Comrade Piercing
helmet.description:
Piercing filled with the
bond between human and cat.
It's warm to the touch.

helmet.name: Hawkeye Piercing
helmet.description:
Ear piercing in the shape of
a predatory bird's tear.
Confers the detect ability.

plate.name: Leather Armor
plate.description:
Made from light materials on
a base of leather.
Protective and easy to use.

plate.name: Chain Mail
plate.description:
Mail made from woven chain.
A piece of armor that has
protected many hunters.

plate.name: Hunter's Mail
plate.description:
Custom armor for hunters.
One of the most common types
of armor.

plate.name: Hunter's Vest
plate.description:
Vest made for hunters.
Impressive parts defend
vital areas like the throat.

plate.name: Bone Mail
plate.description:
Mail made from a base of
monster bone. Experience the
wonders of the wilderness.

plate.name: Bone Vest
plate.description:
Vest made by using monster
bone. Looks worthless, but
actually highly protective.

plate.name: Velociprey Mail
plate.description:
Made of Velociprey material.
Easy to obtain materials
lead to balanced mail armor.

plate.name: Velociprey Vest
plate.description:
Made via a combination of
Velociprey materials and
ore. High practicality.

plate.name: Battle Mail
plate.description:
Custom mail made for
hunters. Protection and ease
of use one can truly trust.

plate.name: Battle Vest
plate.description:
Vest made for hunters. It
has convenient pockets for
bullets on the chest.

plate.name: Vespoid Mail
plate.description:
Mail covered in Vespoid
material. Secret crafting
blocks physical attacks.

plate.name: Vespoid Vest
plate.description:
Vest covered in Vespoid
materials. Special shell
that blocks out Thunder.

plate.name: Hornet Mail
plate.description:
Covered in strong Hornetaur
materials. Known for its
shine and shoulder spikes.

plate.name: Hornet Vest
plate.description:
Covered in strong Hornetaur
materials. Its crafting has
more than 100 steps.

plate.name: Hi-Metal Mail
plate.description:
Mail made from rare ore.
Boasts difficult to damage
strength.

plate.name: Hi-Metal Vest
plate.description:
Made primarily from precious
ore, this vest has a high
resistance to Thunder.

plate.name: Genprey Mail
plate.description:
Made from Genprey materials.
Compared to Velociprey Mail,
this is much stronger.

plate.name: Genprey Vest
plate.description:
Made from Genprey materials,
this thick metallic breast-
plate is quite noteworthy.

plate.name: Kut-Ku Mail
plate.description:
Made from Kut-Ku material.
The strange hue has the hint
of a familiar land.

plate.name: Kut-Ku Vest
plate.description:
A chest protector made from
Kut-Ku materials. Thick, but
light and strong.

plate.name: Ioprey Mail
plate.description:
Made from Ioprey materials.
Complex crafting pushes it
to the top of 'Prey armor.

plate.name: Ioprey Vest
plate.description:
Beautiful armor made from
red scales. Superb item
made via careful crafting.

plate.name: Gypceros Mail
plate.description:
Gypceros hide makes this
armor rubbery and resistant
to physical damage.

plate.name: Gypceros Vest
plate.description:
Gypceros hide makes this
armor highly resistant to
the Thunder element.

plate.name: Cephalos Mail
plate.description:
Made from Cephalos material.
Sturdy armor, but weak
against Thunder attacks.

plate.name: Cephalos Vest
plate.description:
Uses the finest Cephalos
material. A trademark fin
adorns the shoulder.

plate.name: Steel Mail
plate.description:
Uses precious ore in
abundance for unparalleled
protection and style.

plate.name: Rathian Mail
plate.description:
Made from an earth
dominating Rathian. Covered
in damage resistant scales.

plate.name: Rathian Vest
plate.description:
Made from a Rathian. Any
kind of flame is powerless
when faced with this armor.

plate.name: Khezu Mail
plate.description:
Mail covered in Khezu hide.
You feel at one with its
charms...

plate.name: Khezu Vest
plate.description:
Vest covered in Khezu hide.
Its soft skin fits the
body so comfortably...

plate.name: Rathalos Mail
plate.description:
With the power of the ruler
of the sky, its flawless
Defense inspires awe.

plate.name: Rathalos Vest
plate.description:
Even if the sun were to
disappear, this armor would
never extinguish.

plate.name: Plesioth Mail
plate.description:
Plesioth scales sewn closely
together and made into mail.
Can nullify any impact.

plate.name: Plesioth Vest
plate.description:
Suit with Plesioth scales
sewn in. Features a unique
collarpiece and ornaments.

plate.name: Lobster Mail
plate.description:
Made from a base of lobster
shell this solid mail can
hold its own in battle.

plate.name: Lobster Vest
plate.description:
High strength armor made
from bundled lobster shell.
A glimpse into technology.

plate.name: Basarios Mail
plate.description:
Made from Basarios material.
The jutting shoulder plates
are its trademark.

plate.name: Basarios Vest
plate.description:
Made from Basarios material.
This heavy armor is well
balanced and not cumbersome.

plate.name: Diablo Mail
plate.description:
Mail made from Diablos
materials. Terrific strength
that proves desert valor.

plate.name: Diablo Vest
plate.description:
Vest made by using the great
horn of Diablos. Enough to
scare away even a wyvern.

plate.name: Monoblos Mail
plate.description:
Mail featuring a Monoblos's
signature horn. Wearers are
commonly called heroes.

plate.name: Monoblos Vest
plate.description:
Made of Monoblos material.
Boasts Defense greater than
simple fencer's armor.

plate.name: Gravios Mail
plate.description:
Made from Gravios materials,
striking this mail is more
likely to hurt the attacker.

plate.name: Gravios Vest
plate.description:
Armor crafted from Gravios
Shell. Geared towards
elemental resistance.

plate.name: Black Belt Mail
plate.description:
Filled with spirit and given

plate.name: Moss Breastplate
plate.description:
Body armor designed to
resemble a Mosswine. Feel
your inner pig!

plate.name: MelahoaFlowerJacket
plate.description:
Armor with a fragrant aroma.
Those wrapped in its smell
float in nostalgia.

plate.name: Makluva Cover
plate.description:
Armor made from fish scales.
The hard material is closely
knitted to prevent gaps.

plate.name: Bistro Jacket
plate.description:
Worn by those aiming to be
1st-class chefs. Embroidered

plate.name: Velociprey Body
plate.description:
Armor that makes one feel
like a Velociprey. The blue

plate.name: Genprey Body

Will make you as sly as a
Genprey when worn. The green

plate.name: Ioprey Body
plate.description:
Armor that shares the anger
